description: Find public transit stops/stations near a latitude/longitude coordinate in Berlin/Brandenburg, sorted by walking distance. Useful for "what transit is near this address" queries. Data: v6.bvg.transport.rest (community HAFAS wrapper for BVG), no auth required, 100 req/min.

max_distance_meters.description: Maximum walking distance in meters from the search point. Omit for no limit.

results.description: Maximum number of nearby stops to return (default 8, max 50).

name: transport-rest.transit.nearby_stops

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Find Nearby Transit Stops
